name: historia-globe
description: Public read-only history tools: what happened around the world on a given calendar date, every result with a source URL.

tools.name: get_events_on_date
tools.description: Return every event recorded for a calendar date (MM-DD), each with a sourceUrl.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search the hand-checked curated event archive by title, description or place.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Fetch one curated event by slug, including coordinates and sourceUrl.

tools.name: get_coverage_stats
tools.description: Exact build-time coverage statistics and an explicit statement of what cannot be measured.

license: Free to read, no key. Retain attribution; reuse subject to upstream licences. The dataset is a build-time snapshot, not a complete or regionally balanced historical record.
